title: Understood attachment allows a changing view

captions.physics: Ending an exhausted criterion of persuasiveness

meaning: Understanding a familiar criterion’s attraction can let your shared view end it and allow confidence to change.
text: Confidence can become more fluid after a convenient criterion ends. Death in the physical position of Ajna ends an exhausted formula of persuasiveness. The Devil in energy helps examine a familiar explanation’s attraction. The Wheel of Fortune in emotions feels change within an earlier picture. Your view can preserve interest in detail without treating sheer quantity as foundations for truth, allowing explanations to matter through their actual relationship with a question.

Suppose you compare two explanations of a puzzle. One is longer and contains apparently precise details, but some do not relate to the question. **Understanding attachment lets an earlier criterion end and a view change.** Detail’s volume stops explaining persuasiveness. Its attraction offered a feeling of completeness. Your view can now distinguish relevance from a rich account. Changing confidence feels unfamiliar. Yet the short version does not automatically become correct either: each explanation still needs foundations of its own within the puzzle’s material.

The risk is rejecting every detailed explanation beforehand after disappointment. The former attachment continues governing the view through an opposite conclusion. Interest in its power reveals that transition. Quantity’s criterion has ended while substantial details remain valuable. Understanding preserves freedom when confidence may change and each argument’s connection with the question is considered without a compulsory preference for either a long or short account.
